structured.answer: כלל has the cheapest S&P 500 keren hishtalmut on this page, at 0.48% מהחיסכון, with מנורה just behind at 0.49%. I'd go with כלל.

stuck.why: It sits at the bottom of a list sorted from expensive to cheap, so for a second it looked like the cheapest. But its fee says 'עוד לא דווח' with a warning icon.
I had to work out that the cheapest is at the bottom, then scroll to the end.

findings.what: The cheapest is last because the list is sorted from expensive to cheap, so I had to scroll to the end to find it
The last row has no fee ('עוד לא דווח') and is marked 'חדש', and at first it looks like the cheapest because it sits at the bottom
Fees are only shown as tiny percent differences (0.48 vs 0.49 vs 0.5), so I can't tell if they matter
'אין מההפקדות' is unclear: is it good or bad?
Odd icons and numbers like '123 מקורר' and the קופה number mean nothing to me
